decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for dormer roof extensions to 265 Popes Lane, because of the position, design and appearance of the roof extensions, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of  this property and would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original dwellinghouse and the character of the street scene, to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties or the character of the Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area.  The development is in accordance with the UDP policies  ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENVB2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENVN 1.7 (Development near the Metropolitan Open Land Boundary), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is  compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the roof extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the roof extensions is used.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 265 Popes Lane.
Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the east and west elevations shall be obscure glazed, and shall not be repaired otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of roof extension to dwellinghouse.
